limitations: 40 samples per model (38 for grok-4.7, 39 for mimo-v2.6-pro) is a cost interface, not a workload study.
The hard category was sampled from AIME 2025 and historical AIME only, standing in for SuperGPQA and Omni-MATH; means for long-reasoning models on those sets are an extrapolation.
Completion means for several long-reasoning models sit at or near the 16,384 cap.
review.method: 757 metered calls (3 more failed) recorded through the v2 harness path (max_tokens 16384, each model's single pinned reasoning setting) on a deterministic sample of 40 questions per model at the v2 category mix; means of provider-reported prompt and completion tokens per model.
notes: x-ai/grok-4.7 returned 17,763 completion tokens on 1 of 38 calls against max_tokens 16,384 (reasoning.effort medium; xAI accepts effort only). Kept; the harness self-test logs overruns.
x-ai/grok-4.7 reports 1,267-1,575 prompt tokens on every call (others 25-750): the provider adds about 1.2k tokens per call, included in its mean_in_tokens.
reviewed_by: Jack Doherty (Fugal Labs; merging the promotion PR on their approval is the human review)

worker_profile: Protocol v2: direct metered OpenRouter calls through the v2 benchmark harness path (MeteringProxy + harness._call_model, max_tokens 16384, each model's single pinned reasoning setting from data/models_v2.json, full benchmark prompt), on a deterministic sample of 40 questions per model at the v2 category mix (knowledge MMLU-Pro/MMLU, math MATH, hard AIME 2025 + historical AIME standing in for the hard category, instruction IFEval), recorded 2026-11-04. 757 completed calls, 3 failed. Provider-billed and table-priced cost kept per row; no response text, no key material.
